name: v2, Android's 0.5625:1 text cells
notes: Guarded twin corner banks, v2. Each thumb owns one 3x6 bank anchored to its bottom corner; every size and offset comes from the short and long sides (or the remembered tab budget), never the orientation. The pad keeps the chosen size wherever it fits (58 -> 52 -> 46 dp only on short sides). A 12 dp halo round each bank snaps or swallows near misses, at least 24 dp separate the banks in portrait, and every band stays 12 dp clear of every key. One map cell per device: on phones the cell that shows at least 34 columns in landscape with all 21 rows where they fit (about 13 dp), with spare height turned into message rows and status bars; tablets show the whole level when it fits at 12 dp or more. The header stacks in the glass unless sitting over the banks shows more rows. Counts, context candidates and the pad-centre list are layers on the pad; the only pop-ups are the flick legend, the layer name pill and the drawer, all inside the map. Desk: the same banks at 40 dp docked under the whole level with keyboard legends.
